> If your request is more "should we…?" / open-ended than "here's what I want, here's why," consider opening a Discussion instead (once the repo moves to its final location; until then, use the `discussion` label on an Issue). Discussions are better for early-stage design conversations; Issues are for things with a clear acceptance criterion.
